messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — rolling llm-route v3 into EU change window at 22:00 UTC. Plan: FF enable on 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m increments. Will pin to v2 if latency > 200ms p95. See release notes: https://redwood.in/release/llmroute-v3

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy queued for 22:00 UTC. Canary cohort: region=eu-west, cohort=1%. If any "latency_spike" alert fires, auto-drain to 0% and notify #eng-oncall.

Michael: @Sasha quick q — do we pin model runtime version or route variant? want to ensure fallback retains kv cache compatibility.

Sasha: pin routing to v2 (route_v2) via deploy pin. kv cache compatibility preserved. we will keep v3 image but route weight -> v2 on rollback.

Anya: Suggest telemetry gates: p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost delta. Gate thresholds: p95 > 200ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% => rollback. Also add evaluation set sanity check for hallucination regression (quick eval job).

Sasha: ack. I'll add the eval job to release notes and set ff roll window: 1% for 10m, 10% for 10m, 50% for 10m, then 100%. ops oncall can nudge earlier if stable.

deploy-bot: ffctl commands to run during ramp:
```
ffctl set llmroute_v3 true --cohort 1% --meta "deploy-1728123456"
ffctl set llmroute_v3 true --cohort 10% --after 10m
```

ops-bot: Monitoring hooks created: dashboards -> /dash/llmroute-v3, alert -> #eng-oncall. Link: https://dash.redwood/llmroute-v3

Michael: Adding note — version pin will be: route_version=v2, fallback-policy=immediate-weight-swap. Post-deploy we need to capture sample requests for 24h.

Sasha: noted. release notes updated: https://redwood.in/release/llmroute-v3-notes

deploy-bot: Canary completed 1% (22:10). No alerts. Proceeding to 10%.

ops-bot: alert: latency_spike in eu-west at 22:25 (p95 ~ 245ms). rolling back cohort to v2 and opening rollback runbook.

Sasha: rolling rollback now. Running:
```
ffctl set llmroute_v3 false --all
routectl set-weight route_v2 100
```

Michael: Confirmed - traffic on v2. Starting postmortem capture. Tagging logs: deploy-1728123456 rollback

Anya: Re-running evals against v3 on staging to reproduce degradation. Will report in 30m.

Sasha: Thx team. We'll hold the change window until we have root cause. I'll update release notes with rollback summary.
